Accroches écrites : « Signs you're finally growing up » (retenue), « You know you're an adult when » (écartée : ton blague), « Signs of maturity in men » (écartée : plat).

slides.texte_overlay: You choose a quiet evening over a party sometimes, and you enjoy it. Knowing what recharges you is a sign you understand yourself better.
You apologise without excuses. "I was wrong, I'm sorry." No "but." Taking full responsibility is one of the clearest marks of a grown man.
You care more about health than looks. Sleep, food and training become about feeling good, not just about the mirror. Real progress, every year.
You walk away from drama. Arguments online, gossip at work, group chat fights. You simply don't have the energy for them anymore.
You start learning for fun. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I enjoy it far more than I ever enjoyed school.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I enjoy it far more than I ever enjoyed school.

slides.texte_overlay: You save before you spend. Money stops being something to burn and becomes something that buys you calm and freedom. They're people too.
You appreciate your parents differently. You start seeing them as people, not just as parents, and you understand them more every year.
